Question 9
?

The vector-valued function r(y,θ) parametrizes the surface of revolution generated by rotating the curve x=sin2⁡y by 2π radians about the y-axis for y∈[0,π]. Which of the following could be r?

a
⟨y,sin2⁡ysin⁡θ,cos2⁡ycos⁡θ⟩
b
⟨sin2⁡ycos⁡θ,y,sin2⁡ysin⁡θ⟩
c
⟨y,sin2⁡ycos⁡θ,sin2⁡ysin⁡θ⟩
d
⟨sin2⁡ysin⁡θ,2πy,cos2⁡ysin⁡θ⟩
e
⟨sin2⁡ysin⁡θ,y,cos2⁡ycos⁡θ⟩
Submit
